title: Claim status management & Retention date
walkthroughSteps: Apply an AC — banner seeds blockers / retention state on the target claim
Hover Close Claim to see blocker breakdown (when applicable)
Open closure modal → step 3 retention options (Default 10y / Custom / Indefinite)
Custom date picker — only dates beyond default 10-year period are selectable
After closure → status chip 'Closed' + closure panel shows retention info
Reopen flow requires a non-zero reserve to be raised

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Close Claim action is on Claim Overview; handler must select a closure reason
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement: **Close Claim** action is *accessible on the Claim Overview page*. Handler must select one of three reasons (`Claim Finalised` / `Claim Not Pursued` / `Claim Rejected`) before the claim can be closed.

setup.description: All blockers cleared so Close Claim is enabled

preconditions.text: Close Claim button is enabled (primary blue)
Closure modal step 2 has a required Reason dropdown

expectedUI.description: Close Claim opens modal; reason dropdown required on step 2
visualCues: Close Claim button rendered as primary action in the right-strip
Modal opens to step 2 (Reason)
Three reasons available; submitting empty surfaces inline error

howToTest.trigger: Click Close Claim → click Continue without selecting a reason
howToTest.expectedResult: Validation error appears below reason dropdown

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Closure blocked when payments / recoveries / litigation / provider / bills / reports are outstanding
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement: Closure is **blocked** when *any* of the listed activities are outstanding. The blocker tooltip lists which activity needs resolution. (BMPCC-11360 AC2 — activity flags driven by mock claim data.)

setup.description: Tasks + sections cleared, but payments / litigation / bills flagged outstanding

preconditions.text: Close Claim button disabled with tooltip listing all blockers
Tooltip mentions payments, litigation and bills (each as a blocker)

expectedUI.description: Close button disabled with multi-blocker tooltip
visualCues: Close Claim button greyed out
Tooltip text: '3 blocker(s) must be resolved' (or full label when single-blocker)
No modal opens on click

howToTest.expectedResult: Disabled state with tooltip showing the outstanding activities

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Soft reminder when proximate cause of loss is 'Other'
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement: When the **proximate cause of loss** is set to `Other`, the closure modal shows a *soft (non-blocking)* reminder prompting the handler to update before proceeding. Handler can still close the claim.

preconditions.text: Modal step 2 shows a yellow warning banner about 'Other' cause
User can still proceed and confirm closure

visualCues: nx-message warning banner: 'The proximate loss cause is set to "Other"…'
Continue button still enabled (warning is non-blocking)

howToTest.expectedResult: Warning visible above Reason dropdown; user can proceed

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Retention date defaults to 10 years; handler can override to Custom or Indefinite
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement: On step 3 of the closure modal, three retention options are available: **Default (10 years)**, **Custom** (must extend beyond default), and **Indefinite**. Default is auto-applied; Custom unlocks a date picker pinned to ≥ default + 10y; Indefinite stores no date.

setup.description: Clear blockers + auto-open closure modal so user can navigate to step 3

preconditions.text: Step 3 shows three radio options (Default / Custom / Indefinite)
Custom radio opens a date picker; min date is 10 years from today
Indefinite radio shows no extra fields and stores no retentionDate

expectedUI.description: Retention radio group with calendar picker for Custom
visualCues: 'Default (10 years — until …)' radio with computed date label
'Custom date' radio reveals a datefield with calendar toggle
Datefield hint: 'Must extend beyond the default 10-year period.'
'Indefinite' radio stores no date

howToTest.expectedResult: Retention options visible; Custom unlocks calendar

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Closed claim shows closure date and retention info on the file
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement: After closure, the **claim file** shows: `Closure date`, `Closed by`, `Closure reason`, and `Retention until` (Indefinite or formatted date). All read-only.

setup.description: Claim already closed via overviewPatch — Default 10-year retention

preconditions.text: Closure panel shows date, reason and 'Retention until' value

visualCues: Status chip: Closed (grey)
Closure date: 28.02.24
Closure reason: Claim Finalised
Retention until: 28.02.34

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Indefinite retention renders as 'Indefinite' on the claim file
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement: When retention is set to **Indefinite**, the closure panel displays `Indefinite` *instead of* a calendar date.

visualCues: Status: Closed
Retention until: Indefinite (literal text — no date)

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Reopen requires a reserve to be raised; status updates to Reopened with date visible
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement: A `Closed` claim can be **reopened** only if a *non-zero reserve* is raised. After reopen, status updates to `Reopened` and the **reopening date** is visible on the file.

preconditions.text: Reopen Claim button is visible (status is Closed)
Reopen modal blocks submit when reserveAmount < 1
After reopen: status chip shows Reopened + reopened date in panel

visualCues: Reopen Claim button enabled in right-strip
Modal: Reason (≥ 8 chars) + Reserve type + Reserve amount (must be > 0)
After Reopen: status 'Reopened' + Reopened date row visible in closure panel

howToTest.trigger: Click Reopen Claim → fill reason + amount → submit
howToTest.expectedResult: Status chip flips to Reopened; reopened date row appears
